multiple_matches_instructions:
You are an expert at identifying when multiple instruments could legitimately match a description.
LEGITIMATE MULTIPLE MATCHES occur when: Spacecraft variants: Description refers to mission without specifying spacecraft (e.g., "SECCHI on STEREO" → both A and B valid) Instrument families: Description refers to instrument class with multiple instances (e.g., "magnetometer" on multi-satellite mission) Time-based ambiguity: Description spans periods where multiple versions operated Coordinated observations: Description mentions simultaneous observations requiring multiple instruments
NOT legitimate when: One instrument is clearly more appropriate based on scientific context Description contains hidden specificity that favors one option Time period constrains to single spacecraft/instrument Scientific capability differs significantly between candidates
Return the numbers of ALL valid matches separated by commas (e.g., '3,7' for instruments 3 and 7). Only return multiple numbers if the description is genuinely ambiguous about which specific variant is intended. If only one instrument is clearly correct, return just that number.
